title: CHAR-frog-footman waistcoat: appearance.json says mottled olive-green satin, costumes.json COS-036 says plain buff wool

evidence.value: ... over a mottled olive-and-moss-green satin waistcoat and cream knee-breeches ...
... a plain buff wool waistcoat, cream knee breeches ...

problem: The two Bible sources give the default waistcoat different colours and fabrics. Downstream prompts that quote appearance.prompt_summary_en would put a green waistcoat on a figure whose sheet shows buff.
workaround_in_this_task: The sheet follows costumes.json COS-036 visual_en verbatim (SOUL: sheet outfit = costumes.json default outfit). The sheet shows a buff wool waistcoat. No Bible file edited.
suggested_fix: Align appearance.json default_outfit_tone and prompt_summary_en to COS-036 (buff wool), or have costume change COS-036 if green satin is intended; then this sheet would need a rerun at user discretion.

resolution.authority: H2 art-style lock, gate G4, approval ba96732d (runs/g4/gate.json)
resolution.decision: Align appearance.json to costumes.json COS-036 and the H2-locked sheet: a plain buff wool waistcoat.
resolution.reasoning: The sheet was drawn from COS-036 visual_en as the order requires, and buff keeps the waistcoat from merging into the olive-green frog skin. costumes.json stays the wardrobe authority for prompts (runs/g4/gate.json DEF-p4-costume-sheet-901 waiver). The mottled olive-and-moss-green satin reading is superseded, not carried as a variant: it was an inferred colour with no source anchor.
